parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite the destination object with the same name during the CopyObject operation. When the destination bucket is in the enabled or suspended versioning state, the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header is invalid, and the object with the same name can be overwritten.
  - If **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** is not specified or is set to **false**, the destination object with the same name can be overwritten.
  - If **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** is set to **true**, the object with the same name cannot be overwritten.

Setting the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header decreases the QPS processing performance. If you need to use the **x-oss-forbid-overwrite** request header for a large number of operations (QPS > 1000), contact technical support to avoid impact on your business.
Default value: false.
parameters.description_zh:
指定CopyObject操作时是否覆盖同名目标Object。当目标Bucket处于已开启或已暂停版本控制状态时，**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header设置无效，即允许覆盖同名Object。
  - 未指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**或者指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**false**时，表示允许覆盖同名目标Object。
  - 指定**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**为**true**时，表示禁止覆盖同名Object。

设置**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header会导致QPS处理性能下降，如果您有大量的操作需要使用x-**x-oss-forbid-overwrite**请求Header（QPS>1000），请联系技术支持，避免影响您的业务。
默认值：false

parameters.description_en:
Specifies how to set the metadata of the destination object.
  - **COPY** (default): The metadata of the source object is copied to the destination object.
OSS does not copy the **x-oss-server-side-encryption** configuration of the source object to the destination object. The server-side encryption method of the destination object is determined by whether **x-oss-server-side-encryption** is specified in the current copy operation.
  - **REPLACE**: The metadata of the source object is ignored, and the metadata specified in the request is used.

> If the source object path and the destination object path are the same and versioning is not enabled, the metadata of the source object is ignored regardless of the value of x-oss-metadata-directive. The destination object uses the metadata specified in the request.
parameters.description_zh:
指定如何设置目标Object的元信息。
  - **COPY**（默认值）：复制源Object的元数据到目标Object。
OSS不会复制源Object的**x-oss-server-side-encryption**属性配置到目标Object。目标Object的服务器端加密编码方式取决于当前拷贝操作是否指定了**x-oss-server-side-encryption**。
  - **REPLACE**：忽略源Object的元数据，直接采用请求中指定的元数据。

> 如果拷贝操作的源Object地址和目标Object地址相同，且未开启版本控制时，则无论x-oss-metadata-directive为何值，都会忽略源Object的元数据，目标Object将直接采用请求中指定的元数据。

parameters.description_en:
Specifies the server-side encryption algorithm that is used when OSS creates the destination object.
Valid values: **AES256**, **KMS**.
You must purchase a KMS suite to use the KMS encryption algorithm. Otherwise, OSS returns the KmsServiceNotEnabled error.
  - If **x-oss-server-side-encryption** is not specified in the copy operation, the destination object is not server-side encrypted regardless of whether the source object is server-side encrypted.
  - If **x-oss-server-side-encryption** is specified in the copy operation, the destination object is server-side encrypted regardless of whether the source object is server-side encrypted. The response header of the copy operation contains **x-oss-server-side-encryption**, whose value indicates the encryption algorithm of the destination object.
When the destination object is downloaded, the response header also contains **x-oss-server-side-encryption**, whose value indicates the encryption algorithm of the object.
parameters.description_zh:
指定OSS创建目标Object时，服务器端熵编码加密算法 。
取值：**AES256**、**KMS**
您只有购买了KMS套件，才能使用KMS加密算法，否则OSS会返回KmsServiceNotEnabled错误。
  - 如果拷贝操作中未指定**x-oss-server-side-encryption**，则无论源Object是否进行过服务器端加密编码，拷贝后的目标Object均不进行服务器端加密编码。
  - 如果拷贝操作中指定了**x-oss-server-side-encryption**，则无论源Object是否进行过服务器端加密编码，拷贝后的目标Object均会进行服务器端加密编码。并且拷贝操作的响应头中会包含**x-oss-server-side-encryption**，值为目标Object的加密算法。
在目标Object被下载时，响应头中也会包含**x-oss-server-side-encryption**，值为该Object的加密算法。

parameters.description_en:
The access control list (ACL) of the object when it is created in OSS.

Valid values:

- default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket in which it is stored.
- private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users cannot access the object.
- public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.
- public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this value.

For more information about ACLs, see **[ACL](~~100676~~)**.
parameters.description_zh:
指定OSS创建Object时的访问权限。
取值：

- default（默认）：Object遵循所在存储空间的访问权限。
- private：Object是私有资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户没有权限操作该Object。
- public-read：Object是公共读资源。只有Object的拥有者和授权用户有该Object的读写权限，其他用户只有该Object的读权限。请谨慎使用该权限。
- public-read-write：Object是公共读写资源。所有用户都有该Object的读写权限。请谨慎使用该权限。

关于访问权限的更多信息，请参见**[读写权限ACL](~~100676~~)**。
parameters.help_en:
The access control list (ACL) of the destination object that is created by OSS.

Valid values:

- default: The object inherits the ACL of the bucket.
- private: The object is a private resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users do not have permissions to perform operations on the object.
- public-read: The object is a public-read resource. Only the object owner and authorized users have read and access permissions on the object. Other users have only read permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this ACL.
- public-read-write: The object is a public-read-write resource. All users have read and access permissions on the object. Exercise caution when you set this ACL.

For more information about ACLs, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100676.html**

parameters.help_en:
The storage class of the object.
For a bucket of any storage class, if you specify this parameter when you upload an object, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you specify **x-oss-storage-class** as Standard when you upload an object to an IA bucket, the object is stored as Standard.

Valid values:
- Standard
- IA: Infrequent Access
- Archive
- ColdArchive: Cold Archive

For more information about storage classes, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的存储类型。
对于任意存储类型Bucket，如果上传Object时指定该值，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定**x-oss-storage-class**为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard类型。

取值：
- Standard：标准存储
- IA：低频访问
- Archive：归档存储
- ColdArchive：冷归档存储

关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见**https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**

parameters.description_en:
If a parameter is prefixed with x-oss-meta-*, the parameter is considered as user metadata.
Size limit: An object can contain multiple metadata entries, but the total size of all metadata cannot exceed 8 KB.
Naming conventions: Hyphens (-), digits, and lowercase letters (a to z) are supported. Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase letters. Other characters, including underscores (_), are not supported.
parameters.description_zh:
如果配置以x-oss-meta-*为前缀的参数，则该参数视为元数据。
元数据大小限制：一个Object可以包含多个元数据，但所有的元数据总大小不能超过8 KB。
元数据命名规则：支持短划线（-）、数字、英文字母（a~z）。英文字符的大写字母会被转成小写字母，不支持下划线（_）在内的其他字符。
